fusions.name: Long Glide
fusions.desc: You glide up to 7 tiles to the target and land on it, dealing 12 damage, rising to 1.8 times that from the full 7 tiles, and knocking it back 3 tiles.

fusions.name: Plucked Vanes
fusions.desc: Costs 4% of your maximum health. You tear 3 scales loose and throw them at once, spread apart, each dealing 6 damage, with a 25% chance per hit to leave the target [Bleeding] for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Braced Descent
fusions.desc: You glide 3 tiles from where you stood. Your armour rises by 18% for 8 seconds, and you move 20% faster for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Hollow-Boned Mail
fusions.desc: You move 8% faster, and your physical resistance rises by 8%.
